[1/3] Plan: add root-motion extraction (RootMotion, extract_root_motion, in_place_pose, root_motion_report) that returns a clip root's position/rotation delta, optional planar mode, yaw and a pose copy with the root reset, plus a discovery flag

impact_assessment.why: Clips animate root nodes but the engine had no first-class way to turn that into movement; games had to sample, subtract and invert themselves, and Unity/Unreal expose root motion directly.
impact_assessment.benefits: Animation-driven movement and turning become a pure tested delta, with in-place baking for gameplay and a JSON report for evidence.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new module, four exports and a capability; dependency: root_motion imports animation and scene.Transform; concurrency: none; state: pure values.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate node IDs and times, normalize rotations, pin deltas/yaw/planar/identity/validation with tests, and keep the canonical frame unchanged.

[1/3] Plan: add RootMotionPlayer that advances one clip and returns its pose plus the consumed root delta, composing loop seams and whole cycles, clamping non-loop playback, supporting planar mode and reporting state

impact_assessment.why: Root-motion extraction existed but was inert; a game still had to own a clip clock and compose deltas across loop seams.
impact_assessment.benefits: A walk or turn cycle produces continuous motion across wraps without touching the blending controller, and the pose can be stripped in place for presentation.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new class, one export and a capability; dependency: root_motion only; concurrency: player state is caller-owned; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate clip, node, speed, loop and planar, cap loop spans, pin per-step deltas, wraps, multi-wrap, rotation, clamping, reset and validation, and keep the canonical frame unchanged.

[1/3] Plan: add RootMotionBody that spends a clip's root delta through CharacterController, accumulates yaw, returns an in-place pose and reports state, with planar defaults and a discovery flag

impact_assessment.why: RootMotionPlayer produced deltas but a game still divided by dt, fed a controller, accumulated yaw and stripped the root itself; Unity/Unreal do this for you.
impact_assessment.benefits: Clip-driven movement and turning become one step call with collision, an in-place pose for presentation and a JSON report.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new module, two exports and a capability; dependency: root_motion_body imports root_motion, character and physics; concurrency: rig state is caller-owned; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate types, node, dt and colliders, keep planar the default, pin translation, loops, yaw, walls, completion, reset and reports, and keep the canonical frame unchanged.

[1/3] Plan (impact-assessed): add RootMotionPresenter and root_motion_presenter_report to place a container node at a RootMotionBody's position and yaw while preserving scale, apply the in-place pose to its children, and report updated ids

impact_assessment.why: RootMotionBody moved a body and returned an in-place pose, but every game still wired the container transform, scale preservation and pose application by hand.
impact_assessment.benefits: Movement, collision and presentation stay in sync in one step call, with scale preserved and a JSON report of updated nodes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new module, two exports and a capability; dependency: presenter imports root_motion_body, animation and scene; concurrency: presenter state is caller-owned; state: scene node transforms change by design.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate rig and container, sync without advancing the clip, preserve scale, pin following/turning/sync/scale/walls/missing nodes with tests, and keep the canonical frame unchanged.

impact_assessment.why: README sat at 32,379 of the 32,500-character gate, leaving 121 characters, so every further feature note risked the guideline gate.

impact_assessment.risks: contract: documentation locations only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: the link must resolve for the knowledge-base check.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the summary factual, create the doc before linking, add it to docs/TREE.md, and run the full guideline and link gates.
